stage2_results.local_context:
But once people are in the wings, other props draw attention too. Meta employees raised concerns that sensitive information about users, needed to handle the calls, might be shared unintentionally with contract workers at a call center. We should not turn this into a claim that “a major data leak has happened.” The available information does not support that conclusion. The issue was the possibility that the information could be passed to the workers.

Meta executives also admitted that it was a “mistake” to start tests in which contract workers made calls without a proper explanation. Who is speaking to the person on the other end? How should that be explained? If people are working behind the scenes of a service, their presence should also be written into the script.

Meta rolled back its human concierge feature, but it did not shut down Muse as a whole. It plans to keep working with businesses to improve the phone feature, and to release it only when it is ready and can be properly explained.

verdicts.claim: When you hear that “AI makes phone calls,” you might assume the AI is also the one handling the call.
verdicts.reason: 読者が抱きうる想定を述べる導入で、実際の通話主体について具体的な事実を断定していない。

verdicts.claim: It was as if, while you waited for the lead actor to appear, a different actor came onstage.
verdicts.reason: 別の役者が舞台に出るという比喩は、人間の契約スタッフが一部の通話を担当したことを表している。

verdicts.claim: Of course, this is only a comparison.
verdicts.reason: 直前の表現が比喩だと明示する文で、具体的な事実を追加していない。
配役が意外だったという評価・感想で、検証可能な事実を追加していない。

verdicts.claim: But once people are in the wings, other props draw attention too.
verdicts.reason: 舞台裏や小道具を使った比喩的なつなぎで、新たな具体的事実を述べていない。

verdicts.claim: We should not turn this into a claim that “a major data leak has happened.”
verdicts.reason: 大規模な情報漏えいがあったと主張しないよう促す編集上の注意であり、漏えいの有無を事実として断定していない。

verdicts.claim: The available information does not support that conclusion.
verdicts.reason: 大規模な漏えいが起きたとの結論は利用可能な情報で裏付けられない、というLedgerの注意と一致する。

verdicts.claim: If people are working behind the scenes of a service, their presence should also be written into the script.
verdicts.reason: 人がサービスの裏側で働く場合にどう知らせるべきかという規範的な意見である。

verdicts.claim: The main point this time is not just that people appeared in AI phone calls.
verdicts.reason: 人間がAI電話に関与したという点は、人間が一部のMuse経由の電話を担当した事実と一致し、「not just」は記事の主題を示す表現。

verdicts.claim: If people are helping, how and to whom that is explained also becomes part of the feature.
verdicts.reason: 人が支援する場合の説明を機能の一部とみなす、条件付きの規範的な見解である。

verdicts.claim: The audience should be able to tell who the lead is in the call.
verdicts.reason: 通話の主役が誰か分かるべきだという比喩的・規範的な意見で、具体的事実を追加していない。

verdicts.claim: That seems to be what matters if the show is to go on.
verdicts.reason: 番組を続けるために何が重要かについての締めの感想である。
